Annually, it enchants over 100,000 visitors, adding to the charm of the Dalarna region.

title: Interim EC ruling on ‘real TMC’ likely on Sept 17
content:
NEW DELHI: An interesting situation may be unfolding in Nandigram and Rejinagar, with both factions of TMC, one headed by Mamata Banerjee and the other by Ritabrata Banerjee, naming their own candidates for the bypolls while claiming to be the “real” party entitled to use its reserved symbol.EC, which heard the two factions Saturday, asked them to file written replies by Sept 16. title: Bengal cancels noon meal deal in four districts
content: the state school education department has withdrawn its approval for the Akshaya Patra Foundation . the foundation served cooked mid-day meals at state-run schools in parts of four districts . school heads said arrangements were not ready for the foundation to supply cooked meals across the areas .

title: India to export 654MW of power to flood-hit Nepal daily till Dec 31
content: the ministry of power has agreed to export 654MW of electricity daily to flood-ravaged Nepal for 18 hours a day till Dec 31 . floods in the Trishuli/Lhende Khola river basin caused significant damage to hydropower infrastructure in Nepal . india started exporting up to 600MW electricity between midnight and 6pm .

title: SC faults Abu Salem's maths, junks release plea

title: Cong rejects TMC proposal for bypoll pact
content:
Mamata Banerjee

NEW DELHI: An attempt by the Mamata Banerjee faction of TMC to hammer out an alliance with Congress for upcoming bypolls in Bengal did not materialise after the latter insisted on going it alone, reports Subodh Ghildiyal. Trinamool's decision to announce candidates in Nandigram and Rejinagar Monday came well after Congress had named its nominees. But it is learnt that TMC had reached out to Congress with an offer for coordination in the bypolls. The offer was that Congress should contest Nandigram while Trinamool would contest in Rejinagar. However, sources said Bengal Congress did not agree to the proposal as it is looking to rebuild its base in the state and a tie-up now would neutralise this process.

End of Article
